children: Iambic Therapeutics filed a final prospectus for its initial public offering on Nasdaq, offering 9,375,000 shares at $16.00 per share under the ticker “IAM.” The listing is on the Nasdaq Global Select Market, and gross proceeds are expected to be $150 million, with a 30‑day option for underwriters to purchase up to 1,406,250 additional shares. The company plans to use the funds to advance its lead oncology programs and invest further in its AI-enabled discovery platform.

Iambic Therapeutics is a technology and clinical‑stage biopharma company that applies proprietary artificial intelligence and automated laboratory experimentation to discover and develop small‑molecule medicines. Its platform combines Enchant, a multimodal transformer model that predicts preclinical and clinical properties, with NeuralPLexer, a generative structure‑prediction model, and closed‑loop high‑throughput chemistry and biology to continuously design, make, and test compounds.

The company’s lead program, IAM1363, is an oral, selective, pan‑mutant, brain‑penetrant HER2 inhibitor in an ongoing Phase 1/1b trial, with plans to initiate registrational studies as early as 2027 subject to regulatory feedback. Iambic also submitted an IND for IAM217, a brain‑penetrant allosteric KIF18A inhibitor, and expects to file an IND for IAM‑C1, a selective dual CDK2/4 inhibitor, in Q4 2026. Beyond its wholly owned pipeline, Iambic partners with AbbVie, Takeda, Lundbeck, NVIDIA, Lambda, Revolution Medicines, Jazz Pharmaceuticals, and Bayer to deploy its platform across additional targets and therapeutic areas.
: Management cites multi‑billion‑dollar opportunities across HER2‑driven cancers and other indications, including >$10B for IAM1363 and IAM‑C1, and >$5B for IAM217.
: AI-enabled drug discovery aims to shorten timelines and improve success rates versus traditional discovery approaches.
: Positioned as an integrated AI + automated lab platform (Enchant and NeuralPLexer) generating internal pipeline and partner programs.

: AbCellera, Absci, Generate Biomedicines, Insilico Medicine, Isomorphic Labs, Recursion, Relay Therapeutics, Xaira Therapeutics, XtalPi; and HER2 therapy competitors such as lapatinib, neratinib, tucatinib, zongertinib, sevabertinib.
: Rising use of multimodal AI, high‑throughput automation, and pharma partnerships to accelerate discovery and de‑risk clinical development.
: Strategic collaborations with AbbVie, Takeda, Lundbeck, NVIDIA, Lambda, Revolution Medicines, Jazz Pharmaceuticals, and Bayer.
: Headquarters and labs in San Diego, California; additional offices in Bristol (UK) and Dublin (Ireland).
: U.S., United Kingdom, Ireland; multi‑center clinical sites in the U.S., EU, and planned UK/APAC expansions.
: Discovery and technology enablement agreements across oncology, neuroscience, GI, inflammation, and AI model deployment.
: 171 full‑time employees as of September 18, 2026; ongoing Phase 1/1b trial for IAM1363; IND submission for IAM217; planned IND for IAM‑C1 in Q4 2026.
: $12.8 million collaboration revenue (six months ended June 30, 2026); $9.4 million in 2025
: H1 2026 collaboration revenue up 225% year over year (vs. H1 2025)
: Loss from operations of $(82.4) million in 2025
: Net loss of $(77.3) million in 2025; $(50.1) million for six months ended June 30, 2026
, Co‑Founder and Chief Executive Officer - Former Caltech professor focused on computation and machine learning; co‑created the platform strategy integrating AI with automated experimentation.
, Co‑Founder and Chief Technology Officer - Quantum and computational chemistry expert; previously professor at the University of Bristol; leads AI integration and high‑throughput lab automation.
, Chief Scientific Officer - Oncology drug discovery leader with senior roles at Mirati and Pfizer; oversees programs from target ID through clinical proof‑of‑concept.
, Chief Financial Officer and Chief Corporate Development Officer - Former CFO of Recursion and managing director at Laurion Capital; leads finance and strategic partnerships.
, Chief Medical Officer - Former CMO at Zymeworks and leader at Seattle Genetics; clinical development experience in HER2‑targeted therapies.
: J.P. Morgan, Jefferies, BofA Securities, Citigroup

: $75M to advance IAM1363 through Phase 1 and initiate Phase 2/3; $15M to initiate and advance IAM217 Phase 1/2 dose escalation; $15M to initiate and advance IAM-C1 Phase 1/2 dose escalation; $20M to invest in the AI platform; remainder for working capital and general purposes (including potential acquisitions).
